# WA7 · Liên kết "Đến nội dung chính" (khi focus bàn phím)

Group **WA · Khung & điều hướng** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`(app shell)`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#shell`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/workspace-layout.css`
- The shell is drawn once by `clinic.js › shell(content)`: `.sidebar` (menu filtered by `PemaStaff.allowed(page)`), `.topbar` (breadcrumbs, demo account picker, global search, bell, reset), then the page body.
- `clinic.js › shell(content)` writes `<a class="skip-link" href="#main-content">Đến nội dung chính</a>` as the first element of `#app`; `workspace-layout.css` keeps it off-screen until it has keyboard focus.
- State reached with one Tab press on a fresh page: the link becomes visible at the top left and Enter moves focus to `#main-content`.
- Inventory note: First Tab press: the skip link appears at the top left of the content column (hidden until focused).
- Shown with account `owner-tam`; the screen is part of the shell or an overlay (no page key).
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"key":"Tab"}; it must show "Đến nội dung chính".

## Required text (keep verbatim)

## Business rules
- The account picker is a demo identity boundary, "NOT authentication or production RBAC" (header comment of `staff-context.js`).
- The skip link is the first focusable element of every clinic page (accessibility; keep the label "Đến nội dung chính").

## Differences from the app design
- The app has no skip link (touch UI); a web build keeps it as the first tab stop.
- Canvas: the link is drawn focused at the top left of the content column (the old focus ring is a navy outline), over the same Tổng quan page as WB1.

## Gotchas
- Role and page are kept in `sessionStorage` (`pema-staff`); a fresh browser context always starts as `owner-tam` unless `?staff=<id>` is in the URL.
- The snapshot lists the same shell as WA1 (the link is in the DOM all the time); only its position and visibility differ, which is the whole point of this state.

## Web canvas
- Frames: 1440x900 (inventory: 1440x900); screen label `WA7 · Liên kết "Đến nội dung chính" (khi focus bàn phím)`.
- Canvas note: Web › app shell · bấm Tab lần đầu thì liên kết "Đến nội dung chính" hiện ở góc trên trái cột nội dung (khi không focus thì ẩn); app không có vì giao diện cảm ứng, web giữ làm điểm dừng Tab đầu tiên; phần còn lại như WB1
